_comment: Every person who can sign in to any MISMO tool, listed once.
Signing in is global; what each person may do is set per project below.
Roles: 'admin' can also manage accounts for that tool; 'staff' can save.
Omit a project to deny access to it. Remove a person entirely to revoke everywhere.
Changes take effect within about 30 seconds, without anyone being signed out.
Generate name/email/hash with key-helper.html in the initiative-hub repository.
Never put a password here, only the pbkdf2 hash it produces.
